name: Royal Corner Twist 2018
information: The venue is a hotel which sponsors part of the competition cost. There is also a price discount for living on the hotel. There's an registration fee of 150 SEK. The registration will be done through this website. The competition is open for both competitors and spectators but there is a limit of 150 people in the venue at the same time. For more information visit the [website](royalcornertwist.com).
